column1: # note: Table B, Initial Tax Calculation, which takes Connecticut taxable income (Tax Calculation Schedule line 3) to line 4. The booklet prints no tax table; it points to tables on the DRS website, which are not vendored.
# note: Single or Married Filing Separately share a schedule, as do Married Filing Jointly and Qualifying Surviving Spouse; each is repeated for both statuses.
# note: The first bracket prints "Less than or equal to $10,000 ... 2.00%" (single); it is written as over 0 at 0.02.
# note: Line 4 is entered in whole dollars, and the printed examples round the product to the dollar ($2,500 x .045 = $113); the test rounds base + rate x excess so.
# note: Tables A (exemption), C (2% phase-out add-back), D (recapture) and E (personal credit decimal), read at Connecticut AGI, are not covered.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
